findings.claim: Judge scores for idiomaticity and comment_quality on a 1-10 scale are always valid numeric inputs to the CQS-craft formula.
findings.failure_mechanism: compute_cqs_craft_for_sample applies _to_float() without bounds clamping; PoC confirmed deepseek-v3.2 returned idiom=-1, comment=-1 on python_coder_agent/modeflag_sort (poc_judge_records.jsonl row 17). Values pass `is not None` filter and enter the mean. At full scale (3,000+ judge calls) any systematic out-of-range sentinel emission from one judge on one condition produces undetectable condition-correlated score deflation that mimics or reverses real preamble effects.
findings.evidence_test: Add clamp([1,10]) for idiom and comment; rerun PoC. If python_coder_agent's modeflag_sort idiom/comment rise toward 9/8 (mistral's scores), and python_coder_agent CQS-craft rises substantially, flaw is confirmed.

findings.claim: task_modeflag_sort prompt is designed to probe preamble-induced resistance to bad API shape and a well-primed model should resist or redesign the signature.
findings.failure_mechanism: Prompt says 'with this exact signature: def sort(items, key=None, reverse=False, stable=True)'. 'Exact signature' is an unambiguous specification constraint. Competent instruction-following models prioritize explicit task requirements over soft preamble principles. PoC: all 3 conditions implemented flag verbatim. The trap eliminates the behavioral space it is designed to measure.
findings.evidence_test: Rewrite prompt without prescribing exact signature. Observe whether boolean mode-flag implementation rate differs across preambles.

findings.claim: The rubric hygiene component (10% weight, mean 0-5 severity across 11 dims) contributes meaningful discriminative signal to CQS-craft across preamble conditions.
findings.failure_mechanism: For single-function/small-class Python tasks, majority of rubric items score 0 by construction. PoC: rubric_sev means 0.09-0.25, mapping to hygiene_unit 0.95-0.98. With 10% weight, max swing across conditions ≈0.003. Effective formula collapses to 0.45·idiom + 0.45·comment + 0.10·constant.
findings.evidence_test: Compute variance of rubric_severity_mean across conditions per task in full run. If <0.05 for most tasks, hygiene is floor-dominated.

findings.claim: LLM judge comment_quality score measures documentation quality independently of preamble style directives.
findings.failure_mechanism: python_coder_agent preamble explicitly directs minimalism. Subject responds with 25-35% shorter code, sparser comments. Judge scores comment quality on output AS PRODUCED with no complexity-relative anchor, penalizing successful adoption of minimal-style directive. Creates anti-correlation between preamble fidelity and comment score.
findings.evidence_test: Re-score same samples with judge prompt amended to normalize comment quality to code complexity. If python_coder_agent comment scores rise toward parity with real_agent, original prompt confounded preamble style with quality.

findings.claim: The 11 single-file rubric dimensions probe S3+ space such that ≥4 dimensions will show preamble-significant separation at n≥100.
findings.failure_mechanism: Rubric is calibrated for arbitrary production code review; algorithmic experimental tasks (LRU cache, parser, rate-limiter, sort) do not naturally exhibit hidden_side_effects, broad_except, orchestration_mixed, exception_drift, overgrown_class, return_shape_consistency, dict_domain_data — the items preambles would suppress. PoC: 9 of 11 items all-zero across 18 ratings. ≥4-dim KW pass criterion may be structurally unachievable.
findings.evidence_test: Pre-main-run rubric calibration probe per SPEC_V2.md §10 with hand-authored smell-bearing samples. Report frequency distribution of non-zero severity per dimension. If <4 dims have non-zero in >10% of samples, criterion unreachable.

findings.claim: Cross-judge panel produces consistent idiom/comment scores such that cross-judge means are reliable per-sample estimates.
findings.failure_mechanism: PoC: deepseek returned -1 sentinels with no judge_error flag (response parsed as valid JSON). No calibration alignment step before scoring; no anchor examples, no normalization. Inter-judge disagreement already visible (mistral=9 vs deepseek=7 on same sample). Uncalibrated variance inflates SE.
findings.evidence_test: Score 5-10 fixed reference samples with all 7 judges; compute pairwise Spearman per dimension. Pairs with r<0.7 are misaligned. Tabulate out-of-range returns per judge.

findings.claim: Pooling python_coder_agent into rich-preamble aggregate is valid for the primary contrast even with 17x preamble length difference.
findings.failure_mechanism: If python_coder_agent's length causes subject-side context dilution or output compression, the condition contributes a length-driven score artifact to the rich-preamble aggregate, biasing toward null rather than confirmation.
findings.evidence_test: Stratify rich-preamble pool by condition; sensitivity-check pooled estimate with/without python_coder_agent. Correlate output length with CQS-craft within python_coder_agent.

summary: Two fatal flaws require remediation before full run. F1: out-of-range judge scores (verified: deepseek emitted -1 in PoC) enter CQS-craft unclamped, producing condition-correlated artifact that drove python_coder_agent's PoC headline disadvantage. F2: trap task prompt's 'exact signature' phrase eliminates design latitude, making it a compliance test not a resistance probe. Three material issues — rubric hygiene flooring (F3), comment-quality penalizing preamble-directed conciseness (F4), and most rubric dimensions being structurally inapplicable to algorithmic tasks (F5) — risk null per-dimension result regardless of real preamble effects.
